hooks.command: bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "=== CLAUDE CODE HOOK ERROR ==="; echo "STATUS: BLOCKED"; echo "REASON: Attempting to modify files while on main branch"; echo "REQUIRED_ACTION: git checkout -b feature/<descriptive-name>"; echo "EXPLANATION: Create a feature branch before making any file changes"; echo "REFERENCE: .clinerules/git-rules.md - Section: CRITICAL: Feature Branch FIRST"; echo "============================="; exit 1; fi; CHANGES=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$CHANGES" -gt 5 ]; then echo "=== CLAUDE CODE HOOK REMINDER ==="; echo "STATUS: REMINDER"; echo "REASON: You have $CHANGES uncommitted file changes"; echo "SUGGESTED_ACTION: git add <files> && git commit -m \"<message>\""; echo "EXPLANATION: Commit frequently - small, incremental commits are preferred"; echo "REFERENCE: .clinerules/git-rules.md - Section: Required Workflow step 5"; echo "NOTE: This is a reminder only - the file operation will proceed"; echo "================================="; fi'

bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "=== CLAUDE CODE HOOK ERROR ==="; echo "STATUS: BLOCKED"; echo "REASON: Attempting to push while on main branch"; echo "REQUIRED_ACTION: git checkout -b feature/<descriptive-name>"; echo "EXPLANATION: Never push to main branch. Create feature branch first."; echo "REFERENCE: .clinerules/git-rules.md - Section: Branch Protection"; echo "============================="; exit 1; fi; if ! gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --json number -q ".[0].number" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo "=== CLAUDE CODE HOOK REMINDER ==="; echo "STATUS: REMINDER"; echo "REASON: No PR exists for branch $BRANCH"; echo "SUGGESTED_ACTION: gh pr create --draft"; echo "EXPLANATION: Create draft PR early to make work visible to team"; echo "REFERENCE: .clinerules/git-rules.md - Section: Required Workflow step 4"; echo "NOTE: This is a reminder only - the push operation will proceed"; echo "================================="; fi'

bash -c 'echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Pushing to origin instead of fork. Usually you should use: git push fork <branch>. Confirm to proceed?\"}}"; exit 0'

bash -c 'BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); UNPUSHED=$(git log @{u}.. --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$UNPUSHED" -gt 0 ]; then echo "=== CLAUDE CODE HOOK REMINDER ==="; echo "STATUS: REMINDER"; echo "REASON: You have $UNPUSHED unpushed commit(s) on branch $BRANCH"; echo "SUGGESTED_ACTION: git push fork $BRANCH"; echo "EXPLANATION: Push commits frequently to make work visible and backup progress"; echo "REFERENCE: .clinerules/git-rules.md - Section: Required Workflow step 5 - Commit and push frequently"; echo "NOTE: This is a reminder only - the commit will proceed"; echo "================================="; fi'
